events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The Jerusalem church is poor; Paul collects money for it from the Gentile churches.
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Augustus becomes emperor; Corinth is refounded as a Roman colony earlier, in 44 BC.
Claudius expels Jews from Rome (about AD 49); Gallio governs Achaia; Nero becomes emperor in AD 54.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written from Ephesus, about AD 54 to 55

teaser.title: Paul founds the church
teaser.text: Paul stays in Corinth about eighteen months, about AD 50 to 52 (Acts 18).

teaser.title: 1 Corinthians is written
teaser.text: Paul writes from Ephesus, about AD 54 to 55.

teaser.title: Paul returns to Corinth
teaser.text: After passing through Macedonia, Paul spends the winter in Greece (Acts 20:2-3).
